decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposal, by virtue of its location within an area with a PTAL of 1B, outside a Controlled Parking Zone, and in the absence of a parking stress survey, has failed to demonstrate that it would not result in unacceptable pressure on existing on-street parking within the surrounding area. The proposal would therefore be unacceptable in principle and contrary to Policies SC10 and EC2 of the Hounslow Local Plan and the Houses in Multiple Occupation SPD.

Reason : 2 - The proposal, by reason of its location beyond convenient walking distance of town centre facilities, fails to comply with the locational criteria for Houses in Multiple Occupation and is therefore contrary to Policy SC10 of the Hounslow Local Plan and the Houses in Multiple Occupation SPD.

Reason : 3 - The proposal, by virtue of the original dwelling having a floorspace significantly below the minimum threshold of 130 square metres required for HMO conversions, would result in the intensification of a property that is unsuitable for such use and is therefore contrary to Policy SC10 of the Hounslow Local Plan and the Houses in Multiple Occupation SPD.

Reason : 4 - The proposal, by reason of providing only approximately 60 square metres of outdoor amenity space, would fail to provide an adequate standard of private amenity for future occupiers. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy SC5 of the Hounslow Local Plan and the Houses in Multiple Occupation SPD.

Reason : 5 - The proposal, by virtue of failing to provide a dedicated clothes drying area either within the dwelling or elsewhere on the site, would fail to provide adequate facilities for future occupiers and is therefore contrary to Policy SC10 of the Hounslow Local Plan and the Houses in Multiple Occupation SPD.

Reason : 6 - The proposal, by reason of the excessive width and lack of subordination of the first-floor rear extension, the size, siting and design of the proposed hip-to-gable and rear dormer roof extension, and the inappropriate positioning of the front rooflights, would result in an unsympathetic form of development that would harm the character and appearance of the host dwelling, the semi-detached pair, and the surrounding street scene. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies CC1, CC2 and SC7 of the Local Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Reason : 7 - The proposal, by virtue of the scale and intensity of the proposed occupation as an 8-bedroom, 8-person House in Multiple Occupation within a predominantly single-household residential area, would result in increased comings and goings, noise, disturbance and general activity to the detriment of the living conditions of neighbouring occupiers and the residential character of the area. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies CC2 and SC10 of the Local Plan and the Houses in Multiple Occupation SPD.

Reason : 8 - The proposal, by reason of the lack of sufficient information regarding the lawful status, licensing arrangements, occupancy levels and operational characteristics of existing HMOs within the wider area, has failed to demonstrate that the development would not result in harmful cumulative impacts on the character of the area and residential amenity. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy SC10 of the Local Plan and the Houses in Multiple Occupation SPD.
description: Erection of part first-floor side and rear extensions, and a hip-to-gable roof extension with a rear dormer, to conversion of the dwellinghouse (Use Class C3) to an 8-bedroom, 8-person House in Multiple Occupation (HMO) (Sui Generis).
